subject: Enclave accession & environment validation — roadmap and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Enclave accession & environment validation — roadmap and next steps

Hi Alicia,

Great to meet you on Tuesday. Per our conversation I wanted to share a concise roadmap for the enclave accession and environment validation tasks we'll need to complete before we can schedule the day-zero handoff. Attaching a draft SOW, a proposed tenant network diagram, and a starter validation checklist for your engineers.

High-level timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (this week): procurement signoff, SOW acceptance, and exchange of contact + provisioning roles
- Week 1: service account and peering prep; firewall and NAT rules agreed and tested in staging
- Week 2: KMS/HSM integration verification and sample traffic smoke test
- Week 3: day-zero activation and production cutover window (blocked 4 hours)

Immediate asks for Stellar Systems:
1) Confirm SOW document and authorized signatory (I attached RI_SOW_v1_StellarSystems.pdf).
2) Provide account IDs and a network contact for inbound/outbound firewall changes.
3) If procurement needs a pricing breakdown, let me know and I’ll send a formatted quote.

I’ve looped in Kimberly for security/governance questions and Karthik for the network playbook.

Thanks — aiming to lock dates by Friday.

Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Attachments: RI_SOW_v1_StellarSystems.pdf, tenant-network-diagram.vsdx
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@stellarsys.com>

Cc: Stellar Systems Procurement <procure@stellarsys.com>, DevOps Lead <ops@stellarsys.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enclave accession & environment validation — roadmap and next steps

Ben — thanks, this is very clear. A few quick items from procurement and ops:

- Procurement: we need a line-item price for the Dedicated private deployment (monthly), and a one-time onboarding/commissioning fee called out separately. Also please indicate payment terms (Net30/Net45).
- Ops: our network team needs the VPC peering CIDR suggestions (we prefer /24s reserved per tenant) and a list of ports your runtime expects outbound to Redwood control plane.

I'll send a short list of technical contacts in a separate email, and procurement will aim to review the SOW by Friday.

On dates: we are targetting a production cutover in the first week of June, but procurement signoff may push that.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez

Folks — I reviewed the checklist and added a few operational gating criteria (see inline notes in the attached spreadsheet). Quick summary of must-have items before day-zero:

1) Service account with least-privilege roles + short-lived keys for CI/CD integration (ops must confirm role ARNs)
2) KMS key policy exchange and test encryption/decryption sample (we will provide a test vector)
3) BGP/peering health: ensure there is a fallback route and clear NTP/DNS configuration for the enclave
4) Observability hooks: a temporary Prometheus scrape target and an RPM of sample traffic (5k token/sec burst) for smoke testing
5) Access and rotation: confirm a rotation window for credentials within 7 days of day-zero and list primary + backup oncall contacts

If procurement completes SOW signoff by Friday we can target the June 2nd activation window; otherwise propose June 9th.

Marissa Cole
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Alicia / team — brief status update and next actions: 

- Procurement: Ben attached a line-item quote and payment terms (Net30). Please confirm authorized signer and we’ll mark the SOW for DocuSign.
- Network: Karthik confirmed minimal outbound ports (tcp 443, 8443, and udp 123 for NTP) and recommends two /24s for peering (10.200.10.0/24 for management, 10.200.11.0/24 for runtime).
- Ops readiness: Marissa validated the checklist and requested the KMS test vector and a short smoke test (details in the spreadsheet).

Proposed immediate milestones:
1) Procurement to sign SOW (DocuSign link above) by EOD Wednesday 5/26.
2) Stellar to provide network contact + service account ARNs by 5/27.
3) We run the smoke test and KMS sample between 5/28–5/29.
4) Target day-zero activation: 2026-06-02 10:00–14:00 PT (contingent on prior items).

If anything above looks off, flag now. Otherwise I’ll move the SOW into DocuSign and share the signing link.

Thanks — Ben
